title: Streaming replicas with noticeable lag
description: Return only replicas in streaming state with lag_seconds of at least 30. Return exactly three columns: replica_name, database_name, lag_seconds. Sort by lag_seconds DESC, then replica_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT replica_name, database_name, lag_seconds
FROM replicas
hints: Replica state and lag threshold are both required conditions.
Sort by lag first and use the replica name as the tie-breaker.
solution_explanation: The filter must not include stopped/catching_up replicas even when their lag is large.
